For thus says the Lord of hosts:
and build a rampart around Jerusalem.
This is the city of visitation!
Every kind of false claim is in her midst.
Sicut frigidam fecit cisterna aquam suam,
Just as a cistern makes its water cold,
so has she made her wickedness cold.
Iniquitas et vastitas audietur in ea,
Iniquity and devastation will be heard in her;
coram me semper infirmitas et plaga.
sickness and wounds will be ever before me.
ne forte recedat anima mea a te;
lest perhaps my soul may withdraw from you;

Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Usque ad racemum colligent quasi in vinea reliquias Israël.
“They will gather the remnant of Israel, even as a single cluster of grapes is gathered from a vine.
Converte manum tuam quasi vindemiator ad cartallum.
Direct your hand, as a grape-gatherer directs his hand to the basket.
and to whom should I testify, so as to be heard?
and so they are unable to hear.
ecce verbum Domini factum est eis in opprobrium,
Behold, for them, the word of the Lord has become a disgrace.
And so they will not accept it.
For this reason, I have been filled with the fury of the Lord.
Let it be poured out upon the child outside,
or upon a group of young men meeting together.
vir enim cum muliere capietur; senex cum pleno dierum.
For a man will be taken captive with a woman, an elder will be taken captive with one who is full of days.
Et transibunt domus eorum ad alteros,
And their houses will be given over to others,
with both their lands and their wives.
quia extendam manum meam super habitantes terram,
For I will extend my hand over the inhabitants of the earth,
a minore quippe usque ad majorem omnes avaritiæ student,
Certainly, from the least of them even to the greatest, all of them practice greed.
et a propheta usque ad sacerdotem cuncti faciunt dolum.
And from the prophet even to the priest, all of them act with deceit.
Et curabant contritionem filiæ populi mei cum ignominia,
And they healed the destruction of the daughter of my people with disgrace,
quin potius confusione non sunt confusi,
Or rather, they were not confounded with shame,
because they did not know how to blush.
Quam ob rem cadent inter ruentes:
For this reason, they will fall among those who are being destroyed.
In the time of their visitation, they will fall,
et interrogate de semitis antiquis quæ sit via bona,
about the ancient paths, as to which is the good way,
And you will find refreshment for your souls.
And I appointed watchers over you, saying:
‘Listen for the sound of the trumpet.’ And they said:
how much I will do to them.
ecce ego adducam mala super populum istum,
Behold, I will lead evils over this people,
as the fruits of their own thoughts.
For they have not listened to my words,
and they have cast aside my law.
Ut quid mihi thus de Saba affertis,
For what reason are you bringing me frankincense from Sheba,
et calamum suave olentem de terra longinqua?
and sweet smelling reeds from a far away land?
et victimæ vestræ non placuerunt mihi.
and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”
Ecce ego dabo in populum istum ruinas:
“Behold I will bring this people to utter ruin,
neighbor and relative will perish together.”
Ecce populus venit de terra aquilonis,
a people is coming from the land of the north,
et gens magna consurget a finibus terræ.
and a great nation will rise up from the ends of the earth.
They will take hold of arrow and shield.
and they will not take pity.
Their voice will roar like the ocean.
And they will climb upon horses,
for they have been prepared like men for battle,
præparati quasi vir ad prælium adversum te,
like the pains of a woman giving birth.’
Do not choose to go out into the fields,
and you should not walk along the roadway.
and the terror of the enemy is on every side.
Make a mourning for yourself, as for an only son,
quia repente veniet vastator super nos.
‘for the destroyer will overwhelm us suddenly.’
Probatorem dedi te in populo meo robustum:
I have presented you as a strong tester among my people.
Omnes isti principes declinantes, ambulantes fraudulenter,
All these leaders who are turning away and walking deceitfully,
the lead has been consumed by fire;
the molten metal was melted to no purpose.
malitiæ enim eorum non sunt consumptæ.
For their wickedness has not been consumed.
For the Lord has cast them aside.”
